content.title: Ryan Gosling Talks ‘Project Hail Mary’ and ‘Star Wars: Starfighter’
content.text: Sign in to confirm you’re not a bot This helps protect our community. Learn more Three-time Oscar nominee Ryan Gosling joins TODAY to discuss his next highly anticipated movie based on Andy Weir’s novel “Project Hail Mary,” where he plays a middle school science teacher who suddenly finds himself at the center of a daring mission to save humanity.
